sonnet.problem: The question asks for 'the first thing God tells Moses to do to Joshua.' Numbers 27:18 opens with 'Take Joshua son of Nun,' and only then says 'lay your hands on him.' So 'Lay his hands on him' is not the first instruction, and the question claims an order the text doesn't support.
sonnet.rule: Don't stretch the text. Exaggerate only in his own jokes.
